title: REQ · Frame components apply border-image with pixelated rendering and the Button shows four states on the game screen
summary: Frame classes, Frame component, framed Button, wired into screen
description: Context: Button has default and ghost variants only; header, aside and story panel are unstyled. Desired: Tailwind components .sf-frame-* and .sf-btn from FRAME_KIT using border-image and image-rendering: pixelated, a Frame component, a frame Button variant with normal/hover/pressed/disabled, hand cursor class, applied in HeaderOverlay, GameLayout aside, StoryPanel and the Suggest trigger. Expected: framed UI. Why: matches the reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given the generated component CSS, when inspected, then every frame class has borderImage using its PNG path and slice, and imageRendering pixelated
Given Button variant frame with state normal, hover, pressed or disabled, when rendered, then it has sf-btn and data-state of that value, and disabled sets the disabled attribute
Given the game screen components, when rendered, then header has sf-frame-bar, aside has sf-frame-panel, dialogue has sf-frame-parchment and inventory items sf-frame-slot

in_scope: wiring in HeaderOverlay, GameLayout, StoryPanel, App trigger
preserve: default and ghost Button variants (bg-primary test)

definition_of_done: Kit reached from the game screen
non_functional: Buttons keep keyboard focus and aria attributes
